name: tobebestme
description: A mod that runs inside Claude Code itself, not a separate app: what waits for you, your week's limits and what workflows cost. Independent; not made by Anthropic.

sessionBudget.title: ToBeBestMe: budget for each chat ($)
sessionBudget.description: What this chat may cost. 0 means no budget.

dailyBudget.title: ToBeBestMe: daily budget ($)
dailyBudget.description: What every chat on this machine may cost today, together. 0 means no budget.

atBudget.title: ToBeBestMe: when a budget is reached
atBudget.description: warn: a notice only. cheaper: every request switches to the cheaper model, helpers and workflow agents too, except a model you chose yourself. hold: your new prompts wait until you raise the budget; notifications and scheduled runs still arrive.

costAlertEvery.title: ToBeBestMe: cost alert every ($)
costAlertEvery.description: A notice each time this chat passes another multiple of this. 0 means off.

limitAlertAt.title: ToBeBestMe: usage limit alert at (%)
limitAlertAt.description: Warn once a weekly limit passes this. In automatic mode, helpers also switch to the cheaper model.

paceAlert.title: ToBeBestMe: warn when a limit will run out early
paceAlert.description: Watch your pace, and warn when a weekly limit will run out before it resets.

costUnit.title: ToBeBestMe: show costs as
costUnit.description: auto: a share of your weekly limit on a Claude plan, dollars with an API key. limit: always a share of the weekly limit, once this week has had enough use to measure it. usd: always dollars.

contextWarnAt.title: ToBeBestMe: context warning at (%)
contextWarnAt.description: Past this, you and Claude are told to wrap up or save a handoff note.

cheaperModelAt.title: ToBeBestMe: cheaper model at context (%)
cheaperModelAt.description: In automatic mode, helpers switch to the cheaper model past this.

autoCompactAt.title: ToBeBestMe: compact automatically at (%)
autoCompactAt.description: Compact between turns once context passes this. 0 means off; Claude Code's own auto-compaction still applies.

handoffBeforeCompact.title: ToBeBestMe: handoff note before compacting
handoffBeforeCompact.description: Write a note with the goal and next steps before a compaction. It is skipped when the chat is nearly full, or idle for a compaction you did not ask for.

keepPlan.title: ToBeBestMe: keep the plan through compaction
keepPlan.description: Ask the summary to keep the note's goal, decisions and next steps.

mode.title: ToBeBestMe: cheaper model mode
mode.description: automatic: helpers switch when context, a limit or a budget gets tight. always: everything uses the cheaper model, the chat too (a model you switch to with /model still wins). off: never switch.

cheapModel.title: ToBeBestMe: cheaper model
cheapModel.description: A /model name such as haiku or sonnet, or a full model id. The model work switches to: helpers when things get tight, and the whole chat at a reached budget or in Always mode. Choose sonnet for a smaller step down from Opus or Fable.

helpersAlwaysCheap.title: ToBeBestMe: helpers always use the cheaper model
helpersAlwaysCheap.description: Run every helper (subagent) on the cheaper model, however full the context is.

mainToo.title: ToBeBestMe: switch the main chat too
mainToo.description: In automatic mode, switch the main chat as well as helpers.

lowerEffort.title: ToBeBestMe: think less past the warning
lowerEffort.description: Lower the thinking effort once context passes the warning. The next request re-reads the chat once, because a change of effort empties the cache, so it suits setting before long work.

effortLevel.title: ToBeBestMe: effort to use
effortLevel.description: The thinking effort once it is lowered.

workflowCheck.title: ToBeBestMe: check each workflow before it runs
workflowCheck.description: explain: show what a workflow will do as it starts. ask: ask you in the chat before it runs. off: no check.

workflowBudget.title: ToBeBestMe: run budget, then pause new agents ($)
workflowBudget.description: Once a run costs this much, new agents wait until you raise the budget or resume. 0 means no budget.

workflowTips.title: ToBeBestMe: suggest workflows
workflowTips.description: When a task looks like a job for a workflow, say so and which kind.

turnLine.title: ToBeBestMe: line under each answer
turnLine.description: Context, this chat's cost and the turn's cost under every answer.

statusLine.title: ToBeBestMe: status line
statusLine.description: A short summary in the status line.

notifications.title: ToBeBestMe: notifications
notifications.description: When a chat waits for you, a workflow needs your go-ahead or ends, or a limit gets close.

notifyVia.title: ToBeBestMe: notify through
notifyVia.description: both: Claude Code's channel and the system Notification Center. system: only Notification Center. claude: only Claude Code's channel.

notifySound.title: ToBeBestMe: play a sound with notifications
notifySound.description: A short alert sound with each notification.

notifyUrl.title: ToBeBestMe: also notify this web address
notifyUrl.description: An https address that receives each notification, to reach your phone: for example an ntfy topic (https://ntfy.sh/a-long-random-topic) with its free app. Each notification's words are sent there, and they can include a waiting chat's title and a short excerpt, so use a long topic name nobody could guess: anyone who knows it can read them.

tellClaude.title: ToBeBestMe: tell Claude where the budget stands
tellClaude.description: Past the warning, each prompt carries a line Claude reads, so it keeps its steps small.

openOnStart.title: ToBeBestMe: open the dashboard in every chat
openOnStart.description: Open the dashboard beside the chat in every chat: at the start in a wide window, otherwise with your first message.

band.title: ToBeBestMe: line above the prompt
band.description: One line in every chat: what needs you, context, limits and cost, with a button that opens the dashboard.

scanProjects.title: ToBeBestMe: read every project
scanProjects.description: Reads every project's transcripts on this computer and keeps short excerpts of prompts, recaps and questions in ToBeBestMe's store, to show on Home what is waiting and what each project used. Turning it off forgets them.

alertWhenWaiting.title: ToBeBestMe: alert when this chat waits for you
alertWhenWaiting.description: A notification and a sound, once per wait, when Claude asks permission, asks a question or finishes and waits. Works even with notifications off.

speakAlerts.title: ToBeBestMe: say alerts aloud
speakAlerts.description: Speaks a few words with the computer's own voice when an alert goes out.

suggestNext.title: ToBeBestMe: suggest the next prompt
suggestNext.description: Once context passes its warning (60% by default) or after a limit warning, the useful next prompt shows dim in the prompt box. Nothing is typed for you.

githubChecks.title: ToBeBestMe: pull requests and CI in Needs you
githubChecks.description: Reads your open pull requests with the GitHub CLI (gh) when it is installed and signed in. Read-only queries, every few minutes.
